chunks: The day they see it, it will seem they had stayed in the world but only an evening or its turning into dawn.
ai.seo_question: How long will worldly life seem on the Day of Resurrection?
ai.summary: This verse, from Surah An-Naml, highlights the subjective perception of time on the Day of Judgment, where the brevity of worldly life is emphasized as merely an evening or morning. In Shia exegesis, this serves as a powerful reminder of the transient nature of dunya compared to the permanence of the akhirah, urging believers to prioritize eternal deeds over fleeting worldly pursuits. The imagery underscores the suddenness of the Hour, reinforcing the need for constant spiritual readiness.
